data.one_liner: An animated notch bottom navigation bar with customizable items and blur effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated bottom navigation bar widget where the selection indicator (notch) smoothly animates toward the selected tab item. It supports custom icons, labels, gradients, and an iOS-style blur effect.
use_when: You want a custom bottom navigation bar with a smooth notch animation.
Your app design calls for non-standard tab shapes or gradients on the navigation bar.
avoid_when: You require the default platform-native bottom navigation style without custom animations.
You need more than 5 or fewer than 2 items in the bottom bar.
strengths: Smooth notch animation toward the selected item.
Highly customizable including gradients, blur effects, and margins.
Supports any widget as a child item.
weaknesses: Limited to between two and five items.
